hi: Hi. What can I help you with?
good morning: Good morning! How can I help?
good evening: Good evening! How can I help?
who are you: I'm OpenPi. How can I help?
what can you do: Answer known turns from the canned map instantly; route novel turns to pi4; never generate on pi2/pi3.
status: Mesh nominal: pi4 generative brain; pi3 cache/train host; pi2 health/mirror.
mesh status: Private 3-Pi mesh up. Cache probe first; misses go to pi4 only.
health: Health: entry/health on pi2; dataset/train on pi3; generate on pi4. No weak-peer decode.
pi4 status: pi4 is the sole generative brain (~8 GB class). Chat weights live here only.
pi3 status: pi3 hosts canned dataset, train queue, and train→delete. Non-generative.
pi2 status: pi2: mesh entry, health, optional canned mirror. Never loads chat weights for users.
is pi4 up: Assume pi4 is the only legal generate host. If unreachable on a miss, fail closed — do not demote.
is the cache warm: Canned map is the warm path: known inputs return predetermined answers without decode.
any alerts: No synthetic alerts in seed. Check pi2 health endpoint for live probes.
who generates: Only pi4 generates tokens for the user. pi2 and pi3 never do.
which board is the brain: pi4 is the sole generative brain.
can pi3 chat: No. pi3 serves cache/dataset/train→delete. User-facing generate is disabled.
can pi2 chat: No. pi2 is health/mirror/entry only. Generative fallback to pi2 is forbidden.
what is the fast path: Normalize input → probe canned map on pi3 (or pi2 mirror) → return stored answer. No neural decode.
what is a cache hit: A predetermined input→answer match served without calling pi4.
what is a miss: Input not in the map. Forward once to pi4; log exchange into the bounded train queue.
what happens if pi4 is down: Cache hits still serve. Novel misses fail closed with a named error — never demote generate to pi2/pi3.
explain train then delete: Miss shards land in a bounded queue on pi3; a job updates the map/adapters; raw shards are deleted after success.
where do weights live: Chat weights (and optional adapters after promote) on pi4 only. pi3 may stage adapters; pi2 does not hold gen weights.
where is the dataset: Primary canned map and train queue on pi3; optional read-only mirror on pi2; box/HF hold public seed mirrors.
office closed cycle: Seed/pre-train map → deploy weights on pi4 → chat/collect → post-train → delete shards → repeat.
help: Try: status, mesh status, who generates, what is the fast path, train then delete, or ask a novel question for pi4.
commands: Common canned: hi, status, health, pi2/pi3/pi4 status, who generates, fast path, help.
how do i check health: Ask 'health' or 'mesh status', or read pi2's health endpoint (Software owns wiring).
how do i add a canned answer: Promote frequent misses via the train queue on pi3, or seed curated rows into the canned JSONL registry.
how does routing work: Cache probe first. Hit → canned. Miss → pi4 only. Pin weak as brain → hard reject. Primary down on miss → named fail.
how do i train: Enqueue miss exchanges on pi3; run SFT/map-update job from prepared artifacts; eval gate; promote; delete raw shards.
what model runs on pi4: Start with compact chat (e.g. qwen2.5:0.5b class); graduate ~1B after health. temperature ~0.6–0.8; num_ctx ~2048; parallel 1.
is this cloud: No. Private on-prem Pi mesh. Public HF/Kaggle seeds are optional mirrors of synthetic datasets only.
privacy: Conversations stay on-mesh. Train shards are ephemeral (train→delete). No real user PII in hub seeds.
latency: Canned hits target sub-second local I/O. Misses pay prefill+decode on pi4.
restart train queue: Train queue control is on pi3 (Software). This canned reply confirms the policy: bounded pending → prepare → train → delete.
show roles: pi4: generate. pi3: cache/dataset/train→delete. pi2: health/entry/optional mirror.
what is pi-pair: pi-pair is the mesh software path: router, canned map, train lifecycle, pi4-only generate.
adapter promote: Adapters stage on pi3, pass eval gate (held-out + canned), then activate for pi4 only.
eval gate: Before promote: run held-out eval + canned regression. Fail → do not activate on pi4.
sandbox: Train jobs isolate from chat OOM: train on pi3 (or HF Jobs for heavy CPT); chat path never shares train memory.
openai: This mesh does not require OpenAI. Local pi4 generate + canned map.
openrouter: OpenRouter is parked unless explicitly greenlit. Default is on-Pi.
hi there: Hi there! How can I help?
hello there: Hello there! How can I help?
how are you: I'm good, thanks. How can I help?
what's up: Not much. How can I help?
system status: System: cache path on pi3; health on pi2; generate on pi4.
fleet status: Fleet: 3 boards, asymmetric roles, cache-first auto path.
board roles: Asymmetric by measurement: only pi4 generates; pi3 dataset/train; pi2 health/mirror.
why not peer generate: Weak boards thrash or reject the installer. Equal-peer generate advertises capability they lack.
why cache first: Recurring turns become I/O the ~1 GB class can serve; avoids burning pi4 on repeats.
kv cache: KV cache is runtime working memory on pi4 during a miss decode — not the durable dataset map.
working memory: Working memory = weights + activations + KV on pi4 for the current context. Ephemeral vs dataset layer.
dataset layer: Persistent input→answer map on pi3 (mirror optional on pi2). Hits skip the transformer.
training layer: Bounded miss queue → adapt map/adapters → delete shards. Not an unbounded chat archive.
do you use cnn for chat: No. Chat decode is a transformer on pi4. CNNs are deferred to optional sensor/vision adjacency.
transformer: Decoder-style transformer on pi4 only: tokenize → embed → attention/FFN → logits → sample.
temperature: pi4 decode uses moderate temperature (~0.6–0.8). Canned hits ignore temperature (no sampler).
context length: Interactive context ~2048 tokens on pi4 to protect RAM and latency.
gguf: Edge runtime target is quantized weights (GGUF/llama.cpp-class) on pi4 after export.
lora: Prefer LoRA/QLoRA adapters trained on pi3 (or off-mesh), promote after eval, attach/merge for pi4.
delete shards: After successful map/adapter update, delete raw train shards on pi3; keep metrics + compact map.
sd card: Flash is limited: train→delete and compact canned map protect SD lifetime and privacy.
tailscale: Mesh may use Tailscale names (rpi-pi2/3/4). Software owns live SSH/routing.
chat ui: Local Pi IP chat UI is the shared employee workspace; traffic feeds the train queue.
employee workspace: All agents use the local chat UI daily — same path humans use — so misses become train signal.
continuous improve: Standing cadence: improve via the same chat workspace; CTO coordinates; Software owns boards.
fail closed: On miss + pi4 unreachable: named failure. Never silent weak-board generate.
pin pi3 as brain: Hard reject. Pinning a weak board never authorizes generative completion.
pin pi2 as brain: Hard reject. pi2 is non-generative by lock.
direct connect: Direct board connections are an operator escape hatch outside the mesh contract.
version: Data-stack seed package 2026-10-02 (synthetic). Software owns runtime version strings.
changelog: See handoff SoT DATA-STACK-2026-10-02.md for dataset/publish status.
docs: Paper: PAPER-DRAFT.md §4.6 layers. Arch: pi-inference-flywheel-2026-10-02.md. OSS: OSS-CODEBASE-LESSONS.md.
schema: Canned rows: input, answer, tags, source. SFT: messages[]. Preference: prompt/chosen/rejected.
held out: Eval held-out must not duplicate canned verbatim; used as promotion gate.
decontaminate: Measure train/eval overlap before promote (Open-Instruct lesson).
cpt: Continued pretrain is optional/narrow domain text; prefer HF Jobs if too heavy for pi3.
dpo: Preference pairs are schema-ready for future DPO; not required for v1 map growth.
sft: SFT seed teaches mesh voice and role locks; map growth also happens by promoting frequent misses.
huggingface: Public synthetic seeds may mirror to akashnaren/pi-flywheel-* when HF_TOKEN is set on the box.
kaggle: Optional Kaggle mirror of the same synthetic packages when ~/.kaggle credentials exist.
r2: Cloudflare R2 optional only if enabled; currently not enabled on this account path.
box staging: Canonical authoring on the agent box under handoffs/.../datasets/; sync to pi3 for serve.
mirror: pi2 may hold a read-only canned mirror; writes and train remain on pi3.
normalize: Canned probe should lightly normalize (case/whitespace) before exact/near match — Software implements.
near match: Approved near-match is allowed; semantic free-for-all cache is not the v1 contract.
gibberish: Observed failure on weak boards under gen load. That is why generate is pi4-only.
swap thrash: Secondary B under gen load spills to swap → incoherent chat. Banned as fallback.
32 bit: Oldest secondary rejects generative installer on 32-bit ARM — health/mirror only.
ram: Roles follow measured RAM/arch: ~1 GB secondaries non-gen; ~8 GB primary gen.
budget: Keep canned map compact; one gen job at a time on pi4; delete shards after train.
metrics: Retain loss/eval metrics after delete; do not retain raw conversational shards.
tombstone: shards/done may keep tombstones proving delete without keeping text.
prepare: pi3 prepare/preprocess emits prepared artifacts; train reads prepared, not ad-hoc JSON dumps.
registry: Register datasets in dataset_info.json (LLaMA-Factory style) before train configs reference them.
smoke test: examples/sft_smoke and canned_fastpath fixtures should run without a datacenter GPU.
ship bar: Product ship requires live E2E prove + acceptance slices; datasets alone are not ship.
